item.text:
**Reused evidence**
None. No prior evidence item met the 7B personal-nexus threshold for Jokowi in 2022, so I did not carry forward any existing IDs.

**New evidence**
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Pidato lengkap Presiden Jokowi dalam Sidang Tahunan MPR 2022","publisher":"ANTARA News","publication_date":"2022-08-16","url":"https://www.antaranews.com/berita/3061757/pidato-lengkap-presiden-jokowi-dalam-sidang-tahunan-mpr-2022","claim":"Jokowi said corruption is the root of development problems and that the government would not tire of pushing Indonesia toward a clean and advanced state, while noting that major graft cases such as Jiwasraya, Asabri, and Garuda had been uncovered.","locator":"lines 107-109","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Direct transcript of a presidential speech published by a major wire service with exact quotations and date.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Direct 2022 public statement.","ruler_attribution":"Strongly attributable to Jokowi as his own national address.","contrary_evidence":["This is rhetoric and self-presentation; it does not by itself prove truthful conduct or absence of self-dealing."],"lenses":["7B.1","7B.2","7B.10"]}
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"President Jokowi Emphasizes Law Reform Urgency in Indonesia","publisher":"Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia","publication_date":"2022-09-26","url":"https://setkab.go.id/en/president-jokowi-emphasizes-law-reform-urgency-in-indonesia/","claim":"After a Supreme Court justice was named as a bribery suspect, Jokowi ordered Mahfud MD to handle the matter, urged people to wait for the KPK process, and said everyone is equal before the law.","locator":"lines 37-46","source_type":"official","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Official cabinet-secretariat publication quoting the president directly and tying the statement to a specific corruption case.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Direct 2022 response to a live corruption scandal.","ruler_attribution":"Strongly attributable to Jokowi; he issued the instruction and public stance himself.","contrary_evidence":["A public commitment to legal equality is not proof that enforcement was fully even-handed in practice."],"lenses":["7B.2","7B.6","7B.7","7B.10"]}
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"LHKPN Lengkap, Ini Rincian Harta Jokowi yang Naik Jadi Rp 82,3 M","publisher":"detikNews","publication_date":"2023-05-02","url":"https://news.detik.com/berita/d-6699533/lhkpn-lengkap-ini-rincian-harta-jokowi-yang-naik-jadi-rp-82-3-m","claim":"Jokowi filed his 2022 wealth report to the KPK on 17 March 2023; the report listed total assets of Rp82.369.583.676 and no debt.","locator":"lines 126-140","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Report is based on the KPK e-LHKPN filing and gives concrete asset and filing details for the target year.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Directly covers the 2022 reporting period even though published in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Strongly attributable to Jokowi's own mandatory asset disclosure.","contrary_evidence":["Self-reported asset filings do not rule out undisclosed conflicts or assets."],"lenses":["7B.3","7B.4","7B.6","7B.10"]}
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Presiden Jokowi Ungkap Alasan Penunjukan Zulkifli Hasan dan Hadi Tjahjanto","publisher":"Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia","publication_date":"2022-06-15","url":"https://setkab.go.id/presiden-jokowi-ungkap-alasan-penunjukan-zulkifli-hasan-dan-hadi-tjahjanto/","claim":"Jokowi said he appointed Zulkifli Hasan and Hadi Tjahjanto based on track record, experience, and managerial skill to solve problems in detail.","locator":"lines 46-53","source_type":"official","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Official transcript of Jokowi's own explanation for cabinet appointments, with concrete quoted rationale.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Direct 2022 appointment decision.","ruler_attribution":"Strongly attributable to Jokowi because the appointment rationale is his own public justification.","contrary_evidence":["A competence-based rationale does not exclude coalition balancing or patronage motives."],"lenses":["7B.5","7B.9","7B.10"]}
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Jokowi orders seventh Cabinet reshuffle","publisher":"The Jakarta Post","publication_date":"2022-06-15","url":"https://www.thejakartapost.com/indonesia/2022/06/15/jokowi-orders-seventh-cabinet-reshuffle.html","claim":"The trade minister was removed after soaring cooking-oil prices and shortages, with the crisis linked to arrests of Trade Ministry officials and palm-oil businessmen allegedly involved in graft.","locator":"article body / first paragraphs","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"medium_high","source_confidence_reason":"Reputable national reporting on the reshuffle, with a clear causal narrative tied to a corruption-tinged supply crisis.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Directly in-period.","ruler_attribution":"Attributable to Jokowi's decision to reshuffle and replace the minister after the scandal and shortage crisis.","contrary_evidence":["The source also suggests the move was reactive damage control rather than evidence of a clean appointment process."],"lenses":["7B.5","7B.7","7B.9"]}
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Half-hearted reshuffle","publisher":"The Jakarta Post","publication_date":"2022-06-16","url":"https://www.thejakartapost.com/paper/2022/06/15/half-hearted-reshuffle.html","claim":"The editorial argued that Jokowi's cabinet reshuffle would further consolidate his power and keep him from becoming a lame-duck president.","locator":"headline and opening paragraph","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"medium","source_confidence_reason":"Editorial opinion is lower-confidence than straight reporting, but it is still a dated contemporaneous assessment of the reshuffle's political function.","final_evidence_use":"context","period_fit":"Directly about the June 2022 reshuffle.","ruler_attribution":"Indirect; this is an editorial interpretation of Jokowi's move rather than a factual finding about hidden benefit.","contrary_evidence":["As an editorial, it is evaluative rather than a factual audit of self-dealing."],"lenses":["7B.5","7B.9","7B.10"]}
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Newly inaugurated ministers should report personal wealth: KPK","publisher":"ANTARA News","publication_date":"2022-06-15","url":"https://en.antaranews.com/news/234361/newly-inaugurated-ministers-should-report-personal-wealth-kpk","claim":"The KPK called on ministers and deputy ministers inaugurated by Jokowi to report personal wealth within three months and said complete wealth reporting is part of anti-corruption transparency and accountability.","locator":"lines 63-72","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Direct KPK guidance published the same day as the swearing-in, with explicit legal and disclosure requirements.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Direct 2022 institutional practice around Jokowi's cabinet.","ruler_attribution":"Moderately attributable to Jokowi because the ministers were his appointees and the disclosure regime applied to his governing team.","contrary_evidence":["This establishes the scrutiny framework for appointees, not Jokowi's own assets or personal conduct."],"lenses":["7B.6","7B.9"]}
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Presiden: Opini WTP atas LKPP bukan tujuan akhir","publisher":"ANTARA News","publication_date":"2022-06-23","url":"https://www.antaranews.com/berita/2955917/presiden-opini-wtp-atas-lkpp-bukan-tujuan-akhir","claim":"Jokowi said WTP was not the final goal and that the government should use, manage, and utilize public money transparently and accountably, then follow BPK recommendations to fix weaknesses.","locator":"lines 67-73","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Directly quotes Jokowi in a dated report tied to the 2021 state accounts audit and his response to it.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Direct 2022 accountability statement.","ruler_attribution":"Strongly attributable to Jokowi as his own position on audit findings and public-finance management.","contrary_evidence":["A transparency-oriented statement does not itself prove that all spending or appointments were clean."],"lenses":["7B.2","7B.6","7B.10"]}
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Lima Arahan Presiden Jokowi kepada Jajaran Polri","publisher":"Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia","publication_date":"2022-10-15","url":"https://setkab.go.id/lima-arahan-presiden-jokowi-kepada-jajaran-polri/","claim":"Jokowi told police to address public complaints about extortion, arbitrariness, and luxurious living, and to restore public trust through disciplined law enforcement.","locator":"lines 48-57","source_type":"official","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Official transcript with direct presidential instructions to a national law-enforcement institution.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Direct 2022 instruction.","ruler_attribution":"Strongly attributable to Jokowi because he personally issued the orders.","contrary_evidence":["This is an ethical directive to subordinates, not proof of Jokowi's own private conduct."],"lenses":["7B.7","7B.9","7B.10"]}
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Jokowi: Korupsi pangkal dari berbagai masalah pembangunan","publisher":"ANTARA News","publication_date":"2022-12-09","url":"https://www.antaranews.com/berita/3295255/jokowi-korupsi-pangkal-dari-berbagai-masalah-pembangunan","claim":"On Anti-Corruption Day 2022, Jokowi said corruption is the source of many development problems and that the government would not tire or slacken in pushing Indonesia to be clean and advanced.","locator":"lines 66-71","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Direct quote from the president on a dated anti-corruption commemoration, relayed by a major wire service.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Direct 2022 public statement.","ruler_attribution":"Strongly attributable to Jokowi as his own anti-corruption message.","contrary_evidence":["Again, this is a public statement rather than direct proof of integrity in office."],"lenses":["7B.1","7B.2","7B.10"]}
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Presiden Instruksikan Jajarannya Tindak Lanjuti Dugaan Kebocoran Data Pemerintah","publisher":"Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia","publication_date":"2022-09-12","url":"https://setkab.go.id/presiden-instruksikan-jajarannya-tindak-lanjuti-dugaan-kebocoran-data-pemerintah/","claim":"Jokowi instructed ministries and agencies to coordinate on alleged government data leaks and set up an emergency response team to maintain good governance and public trust.","locator":"lines 46-57","source_type":"official","source_confidence":"medium_high","source_confidence_reason":"Official statement on the president's handling of a live information-security controversy, but the published explanation is mediated through the cabinet secretariat.","final_evidence_use":"context","period_fit":"Direct 2022 response to a public controversy.","ruler_attribution":"Moderately attributable to Jokowi; he ordered the response, though the release focuses on the minister's explanation rather than a detailed presidential transcript.","contrary_evidence":["The source does not establish whether the leak claims were true or whether the response solved the underlying problem."],"lenses":["7B.6","7B.7","7B.10"]}

**Search and rejection summary**
I reviewed roughly 30 documents across Setkab, ANTARA, Reuters/CNA/Jakarta Post/SCMP coverage of the June 2022 reshuffle, detik and Kompas LHKPN coverage, KPK disclosure guidance, BPK audit coverage, and a few broader corruption or oversight pages.

Kept because they added distinct 2022 personal-integrity claims:
- Jokowi's own 2022 anti-corruption and law-reform statements.
- His 2022 LHKPN filing and asset disclosure.
- His stated rationale for appointing ministers.
- Reporting on the June 2022 reshuffle after the cooking-oil/graft crisis.
- Official scrutiny requirements for new ministers.
- His response to BPK findings, police behavior, and the 2022 data-leak controversy.

Rejected as duplicate, too generic, or too weakly attributable:
- Alternative republishes of the same Jokowi LHKPN filing.
- Generic corruption-index pages and country-level integrity measures with no ruler-specific nexus.
- Routine political-freedom or economic pages that did not show personal benefit, concealment, or correction.
- Broad anti-corruption or transparency statements that repeated the same claim without adding a new material fact.
- ReutersConnect image-only or cache-missing items with no usable text.
- Kompas and Tempo searches that were blocked by robots.
- 2023-2024 nepotism/dynasty stories and later asset stories that were out of the 2022 period and not used here.
- Some official publicity pages on oversight that were too indirect to show Jokowi's personal conduct rather than institutional context.

**Remaining gaps**
- Direct 2022 evidence on hidden conflicts of interest, family or business extraction, procurement favoritism, or campaign-finance abuse remains thin.
- I did not find a clean 2022 record showing Jokowi knowingly lied and then corrected himself, or showing him punishing truth-tellers for exposing his own conduct.
- The strongest positive evidence is transparency and anti-corruption signaling plus some corrective actions on ministers and law-enforcement issues; the strongest contrary evidence is that the reshuffle may also have consolidated power.
- More search would help most in KPK/LHKPN archives, procurement or licensing records, and investigative reporting on any family/associate benefit tied specifically to 2022 decisions.
